description: Paid: 0.003 RLUSD per call via x402 on XRPL mainnet (xrpl:0), or 0.003 USDC on Base (eip155:8453). Pay per call, solves one question: What public crawler/agent-access files does this domain serve? Raw robots.txt groups, Content-Signal, llms.txt, well-known JSON, security.txt, TDM headers. Without payment this returns isError with the x402 PaymentRequired object (fresh invoiceId); retry with the signed payload in _meta["x402/payment"] or the payment_signature argument. Unpaid calls cost nothing.

domain.description: Tracked domain from the free index /v1/access-policy/index, e.g. cloudflare.com

payment_signature.description: Optional. Base64 x402 PAYMENT-SIGNATURE value (signed RLUSD or USDC PaymentPayload) for hosts that cannot set _meta["x402/payment"]. Omit on the first call to receive the payment requirements.

name: get_access_policy_reading
title: Agent access-policy readings for one domain (paid: 0.003 RLUSD / 0.003 USDC on Base / 0.003 RLUSD on Base via x402)
